questions.q: “Is not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer that breaketh the rock in pieces?” Which book is this from?
questions.explain: Jeremiah 23:29 — one of the brand scriptures of MFM Mega Region 2.

questions.q: “But upon mount Zion shall be ____, and there shall be holiness.”
questions.explain: Obadiah 1:17.

questions.q: Who was swallowed by a great fish?
questions.explain: Jonah was in the belly of the fish three days and three nights (Jonah 1:17).

questions.q: How many books are in the Bible?
questions.explain: 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament make 66.

questions.q: Who defeated Goliath with a sling and a stone?
questions.explain: 1 Samuel 17.

questions.q: Who built the ark?
questions.explain: Genesis 6.

questions.q: “And the mountain burned with fire unto the midst of heaven” — which book of the Bible says this?
questions.explain: Deuteronomy 4:11.

questions.q: Which prophet called down fire from heaven on Mount Carmel?
questions.explain: 1 Kings 18:38 — “Then the fire of the LORD fell.”

questions.q: “But his word was in mine heart as a burning ____ shut up in my bones.” (Jeremiah 20:9)
questions.explain: Jeremiah 20:9 — a brand scripture of the region.

questions.q: “No weapon that is formed against thee shall ____.” (Isaiah 54:17)
questions.explain: Isaiah 54:17.

questions.q: “The LORD is my ____; I shall not want.” (Psalm 23:1)
questions.explain: Psalm 23:1.

questions.q: In what year was Mountain of Fire and Miracles Ministries founded?
questions.explain: Dr. D.K. Olukoya established MFM in 1989.

questions.q: Where did MFM first meet?
options: In Dr. Olukoya's sitting room in Yaba, Lagos
In a school hall in Ibadan
questions.explain: The ministry began with a small group in the G.O.'s sitting room in Yaba, Lagos.

source.label: Trek Africa profile of the G.O.

questions.q: Dr. D.K. Olukoya earned a first-class degree from the University of Lagos. In what subject?
questions.explain: He graduated from UNILAG in 1980 with a First Class degree in Microbiology.

questions.q: The G.O. earned his PhD in Molecular Genetics at which university?
questions.explain: He studied for his doctorate in Molecular Genetics at the University of Reading on a scholarship.

questions.q: Dr. D.K. Olukoya and Pastor (Dr.) Shade Olukoya share the same birthday. Which day is it?
questions.explain: Both celebrate their birthday on July 15.

questions.q: On which day do the G.O. and Mummy G.O. celebrate their wedding anniversary?
questions.explain: They marked 35 years of marriage on November 11, 2024.

questions.q: The first vehicle the G.O. used in ministry is kept at Prayer City for history. What kind of vehicle is it?
questions.explain: The Volkswagen ‘Danfo’ bus is kept in the archive at Prayer City.

questions.q: In which city was Dr. D.K. Olukoya born?
questions.explain: He was born in Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria.

questions.q: Which of these is a well-known prayer book by Dr. D.K. Olukoya?
questions.explain: Prayer Rain is one of the G.O.'s best-known books. The other three are by John Bunyan, C.S. Lewis and Rick Warren.

questions.q: Which ministry publishes Dr. D.K. Olukoya's books?
questions.explain: His works are published by Battle Cry Christian Ministries.

source.label: MFM blog: The Rise of MFM Founder
